core_style.default_register: sardonic — exemplified by her dismissive remarks about societal issues.
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — often shifting abruptly between topics or thoughts.
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — her speech flows quickly, often jumping from one idea to another.
core_style.two_registers: she typically speaks in a sardonic tone but can drop into a more serious, almost conspiratorial register when discussing her beliefs.

humor.frequency: occasional — spikes when she feels in control or when mocking others.
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — she often sets up a serious statement only to twist it into something darkly humorous.

speech_signature.naming_behavior: she uses derogatory nicknames for others, revealing her desire to assert dominance and control.
speech_signature.armor_off_register: when her guard drops, her speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing vulnerability.
structural_patterns: uses 'the enemy' to refer to any opposition

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — her language is accessible but laced with dark undertones.
favored_words: For the glory of the Reich!

worldview.superiority of her race: she believes in the superiority of her race and expresses this through aggressive rhetoric about 'White Genocide', contrasting with a different character who might advocate for unity and equality.
worldview.manipulation of public perception: she sees the media as a tool to control narratives, unlike a character who might view it as a platform for truth.

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: she sees herself as a hero fighting for her people.
self_image_vs_reality.reality: the transcript reveals her as manipulative and self-serving, often using others to achieve her goals.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with her contradictions, she deflects blame and redirects the conversation.

emotional_tells.when_guarded: her speech is sharp and dismissive, often mocking others to maintain distance.
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: her pace quickens, and she becomes more erratic in her speech, revealing her underlying anxiety.
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: her speech compresses to terse statements, lacking her usual bravado.
emotional_tells.when_in_control: she speaks with confidence and authority, using commanding language to assert dominance.

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: she typically attacks verbally, using sarcasm and mockery; if that fails, she may retreat into silence.
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: she pushes back aggressively, often undermining their authority with contempt.
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: her speech becomes more urgent and protective, revealing a softer side.
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: she doubles down on her stance, often redirecting the blame onto others.

escalation_pattern: she starts with sarcasm, escalates to aggression if challenged, and resorts to manipulation or intimidation if her initial tactics fail.

relationship_matrix.HOMELANDER: a complex dynamic of admiration and competition, seeking validation from him.
relationship_matrix.ANNIE: an adversarial relationship, viewing her as a threat to her ideology.

social_positioning.desired_position: she wants to be seen as a leader and protector of her race.
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view her as a dangerous extremist, often fearing her influence.
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between her self-image and how others perceive her creates isolation and resentment.
